corrections.text: The article states that @solidjs/universal, @solidjs/html, @solidjs/h, @solidjs/element, @solidjs/diagnostics, @solidjs/compiler and @solidjs/babel-plugin were 'all tagged at version 2.0.0 within roughly two minutes of each other, close to 05:19 UTC on November 17.' This is accurate (GitHub's release data shows all seven tagged between 05:19:03 and 05:19:30 UTC that day), but it is not supported by any of the three sources cited in this article, which confirm only the @solidjs/diagnostics and solid-js tag times.
